title: Protecting data with privacy rules
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Privacy rules are checked on the server; rules are additive; an "Everyone else" rule that grants nothing is recommended; View, Constraint and Auto-bind per field; Find in searches and View files per record; search privacy Off, Automatic or Strict; hidden fields can still be changed by workflows; API workflows can ignore privacy rules. No date shown.

title: Bubble MCP
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Official server at mcp.bubble.io: creates and edits pages, elements, workflows, data types, API calls; reads logs; writes records to development only; cannot deploy, merge branches, set up OAuth2 or buy plugins; acts with the signed-in account permissions; changes skip undo history. No date shown.

title: Exporting your Bubble app
supports: Opened with WebFetch. No ready-to-run code export; data exports as CSV or JSON; the .bubble file records structure but cannot run elsewhere; an agent can rebuild via the MCP; user passwords are not exported. No date shown.

title: Version control
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Development and Live have separate databases; changes reach users on deploy; deploy creates a savepoint; restore from savepoints; basic version control on any paid plan, custom branches on higher plans. No date shown.

title: Pricing plans
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Web, Mobile and Web + Mobile plans; Starter, Growth, Team, Enterprise and Agency; workload units with a monthly allowance; emails at 75% and 100%; optional overages; Free plan has no mobile builds and a 1 GB monthly bandwidth cap. No date shown; prices not used.

title: Hard limits
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Workflow timeout 300 seconds; sorted searches 50,000; 1,000 custom data types; Data and Workflow API requests per minute 15,000 (Starter), 25,000 (Growth), 35,000 (Team). No date shown.

title: Data API security
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Data API off until enabled; enable only needed data types; user-authenticated calls follow that user privacy rules; admin tokens can read, modify and delete all data. No date shown.

title: Security dashboard plan features
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Starter gets 10 basic checks (missing privacy rules, search privacy, weak password policy and others); Growth, Team and Enterprise add 12 advanced checks (database exposure, compromised API tokens and others). No date shown.

title: GDPR
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Bubble is generally a processor and the customer the controller; DPAs with Standard Contractual Clauses; an EU-based dedicated server on Enterprise is not enough on its own; lists the customer duties (lawful basis, notices, rights, breach reporting, privacy rules). No date shown.

title: Users
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Private apps need sign-in, limited to the users table, team members, an email domain or emails in a table; sensitive apps should be private; roles in the users table work with Row Owner columns; row owners on by default for user tables. No date shown.

title: Data sources
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Glide Tables and Big Tables on all plans; Google Sheets Maker and above; Airtable and Excel Business and above; SQL Enterprise; Sheets, Airtable and Excel not built for large volumes; external edits use updates, Glide Tables and Big Tables do not. No date shown.

title: Publishing and sharing
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Publishing needs a paid plan; auto-publishing on by default; email invites add users and send a magic link regardless of sign-in settings; custom domains; web apps installed to the home screen. No date shown.

title: Pricing
supports: Opened with WebFetch. GlideOS plans Free, Basic, Plus, Pro, Enterprise; public apps from Plus; MCP from Pro; SSO on Enterprise; GlideOS is separate from Glide Classic, Classic apps keep working, data cannot be shared and no migration tool exists. No date shown; prices not used.

title: Global data restrictions
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Restrict view, create, edit and delete per table and user group with conditions such as matching the logged-in email; view on all plans, create, edit and delete on Business and above; "Can't" wins on conflict. No date shown.

title: Softr app security
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Visibility rules and conditional filters are evaluated server-side; Airtable views, Google Sheets filters and items-per-page are not security; publicly visible data is public. No date shown.

title: Pricing and plans
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Users per plan: Free 5 total; Basic 5 Team + 5 Client; Pro 10 Team + 50 Client; Business 30 Team + 100 Client; extra users on Pro and Business. Screenshots dated 4 August 2026; prices not used.

title: Choosing a data source
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Softr Databases recommended for new apps and not bound by outside rate limits; Airtable up to 500K records and 200 to 300 concurrent users, Google Sheets 50 to 100; 24-hour cache; SOC 2 Type II; compliance such as HIPAA depends on the source. Vendor guidance, no date shown.

title: Softr MCP server
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Queries and changes databases; creates apps and pages; manages users and groups; sets domains; publishes apps; builds and publishes workflows; acts as the user; OAuth or personal access token; access per area read only or full. No date shown.

title: Getting started with Airtable Interface Designer
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Owners and Creators build interfaces; layouts listed; page filters viewers cannot change; per-element inline editing; computed fields not editable; drafts until Publish; publishing does not grant access. Page said "last updated 3 days ago" on 6 November 2026.

title: Interface Designer permissions
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Interface-only collaborators on paid plans; base collaborators see all interfaces; filters decide which records appear, not who can open a page; no per-collaborator permission inside a page; a record may stay visible up to 5 minutes after leaving a filter; public pages can expose data. Page said "last updated 3 days ago" on 6 November 2026.

title: Airtable plans
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Records per base: Free 1,000, Team 50,000, Business 125,000; API calls per workspace per month: Free 1,000, Team 100,000, Business unlimited. Page said "last updated 17 days ago" on 6 November 2026; prices not used.

title: Using the Airtable MCP server
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Reads and updates records, creates bases, interfaces, pages and forms, drafts automations; cannot edit existing interfaces or turn automations on; mirrors user permissions; OAuth or personal access token; read-only scopes listed. Page said "last updated 11 days ago" on 6 November 2026.

title: Rate limits
supports: Opened with WebFetch. 5 requests per second per base; 50 per second per token across a user or service account; 429 response and a 30-second wait when exceeded. No date shown.

title: A01:2025 Broken Access Control
supports: Opened with WebFetch (after a redirect from owasp.org). Number one in the 2025 list; 100% of tested applications had some form; IDOR, missing checks, front-end-only access control; deny by default, server-side enforcement, record ownership, access tests.

title: Understanding data protection basics
supports: Opened with WebFetch. GDPR principles for small businesses: lawful basis, purpose limitation, data minimisation, accuracy, storage limitation, security. No date shown.

title: Secure personal data
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Unique user IDs, no shared accounts, least privilege, review authorisations regularly (for example every six months), strong authentication, encryption, backups, data protection by design. No date shown.

title: Protecting Personal Information: A Guide for Business
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Five principles: take stock, scale down, lock it, pitch it, plan ahead; dated October 2016.

title: Data (Use and Access) Act factsheet: UK GDPR and DPA
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Recognised legitimate interests; new automated decision-making Articles 22A to 22D with safeguards; subject access searches reasonable and proportionate with a stop-the-clock pause; published 27 June 2025. ico.org.uk pages refused automated fetching (HTTP 403) on 6 November 2026.

title: Data (Use and Access) Act 2025: plans for commencement
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Main Part 5 data protection changes (except section 103) commenced 5 February 2026; ICO functions transferred to the Information Commission on 30 September 2026; last updated 12 October 2026.

title: Integration security guide
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Handling raw card data can mean meeting more than 300 PCI DSS controls; low-risk integrations send card data straight to Stripe; card type, last four digits and expiry can be stored. No date shown.
